reason: Provides a DSH settings interface for configuring, enabling, disabling, and dynamically mounting local stdio or remote HTTP MCP servers, making their tools available at runtime.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置页配置、启用或停用本地 stdio 与远程 HTTP MCP 服务器，并动态管理其工具挂载。
summaries.en: Configure, enable, disable, and dynamically mount local stdio or remote HTTP MCP servers from the DSH settings page.

capabilities: Configures and dynamically mounts MCP server instances
Connects to configured streamable HTTP MCP URLs
Registers and removes MCP tools at runtime
Persists server configuration and enabled state
